what_it_leaves.a_hypothesis_worth_testing_and_not_yet_t: FOUR is the hyper-connection multiplicity of this model.  A view whose leading axis is the four HC streams, used where the compressed-GROUP axis is meant, is correct for up to four groups and wrong from five -- and it is the exact confusion runtime/sim/memory.py's own docstring warns about: 'its leading axis is the four hyper-connection streams while the loop steps over tokens ... clamping such a view would present four streams as one'.  The resolver guard landed earlier in this session is the same family of error, found from the other end.
what_it_leaves.the_compressed_group_count: prefill compresses floor(span / 2) groups at ratio 2: eight and nine tokens both give FOUR, ten and eleven give five, twelve gives six.  Four works and five does not, at every length tested.

what_the_bracket_rules_out.the_candidate_block_count: nine and ten tokens BOTH have two candidate blocks -- one complete and one partial -- and nine passes while ten fails.  So the block count is not the variable, and the partial-block hypothesis I offered twice is dead.
